searchText: I can't seem to find an answer to the question of post-merge gasLimit value for blocks - are there plans to increase it and is it going to be hardcoded or will the validators set it independly just like miners set it now? Thank you for your help. <@!575359487410700289> as of now it will be controllable by validators, like it is with miners now Thank you, <@!552133098075193354> for your answer. So if I understand correctly, validators will be able to start progressively raising the 30m gas “hard per-block cap” limit as soon as the merge is complete. If they choose to, yes. Most (all?) of the reasons for a 30m cap still apply post merge though
